verdict_scope: Technical coherence and source-bound accuracy of this comparative proposal as a proposal for user decision, not an implemented model or an executable MCMC protocol.

coverage.assessment: Correctly delimited. F1/F2 independently rederived; no sampler or prior explanation asserted from an observed successful run.
Distinct statistical targets. Kernel zeroing is not treated as normalization, rectangle normalization is not physical support, and D is not an exact qbl port.

Correct. P(R|z,theta)=base(R|theta)*C(z,R,theta)/C(z,theta). Global normalization also reweights classes. Inactive count priors integrate to one and retain their marginal law. Verified with all four counts at N=2.

Count mechanism marginalizes exactly to the stated multinomial. Reservoirs, conservation, binomial marginals, negative covariance and stable sequential factorization checked independently, including boundaries.

Six predictors, alpha+b0, Exp(5) on variance, partial pi order and three-term marginalization agree with the proposed comparison. Removing auxiliary counts and using continuous fractions are explicit substantive changes, not preservation of the integral JAGS target.

Multinomial splitting conditional on observed W is correct given parameters and class drawn from their full-data posterior. Complete conditional law and distribution of M+S verified, not just means. Prior class weights would be incorrect for reconstruction.

Correct local conditional equivalence. Does not assert equivalence of hierarchical marginal models. Equality of observed probabilities does not identify transfers or fraud; restrictions may be informative or prior-driven and need separate assessment.
O is correctly a residual if N-A is turnout. No opponent-specific margin is identified from undifferentiated S. Brazilian converter and electoral definitions remain future contract work.

Prospective guidance, not a frozen runnable protocol. Distinguishes diagnostic undefinedness, theoretical constants and sampling failures, and does not waive historical tail ESS criteria. Nine historical NAs remain.

User decision, new mathematical contract and independent review precede implementation/estimation. G10 dependencies and replication gaps match archived evidence. Printed P23 equation 4d omission remains documented in the benchmark contract; proposed k+ formula is supported by P22 and JAGS, not a literal transcription of that P23 typo.

verification.failure_repair_assessment: Algebraically equivalent stable denominator, earlier preservation of CSV output, scalar-name removal and an added diagnostic probe only. No changed grid, probability target or acceptance tolerance.
verification.source_code_executed: New independent QA code plus the three deterministic demonstration scripts; no recovered historical G3 scripts, production runners or MCMC.

unverified_or_not_claimed: Identification, detection validity, likelihood gradients, posterior geometry, scale, speed or convergence of any future fitted model.
A complete prospective diagnostic protocol: thresholds, monitored functions and precision budgets must be chosen and frozen later.
